items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: Jelly and I were pretty close. We did a lot of running around together.

ctx.x: Did a lot of work in there. A lot of he and his bike. Can you tell me more about Jelly Roll when you first heard him about how early he got up here?

Well, I heard Jelly. Jelly and I were pretty close. We did a lot of running around together. Around, around, during the fair in Frisco. I come back here then. Jelly was raising a heck around here then. That was 1915 when I come back to Chicago from San Francisco after the fair. And then we went back to California and Jelly went back. Jelly waked at the Cadillac and we waked at the Waldorf.
